places.name: Ḫattuša
places.note: Boğazköy (Boğazkale). Includes mentions of the land of Ḫatti.

places.name: Arinna
places.note: Location unknown, about a day's journey from Ḫattuša. Alaca Höyük is one proposal among several.

places.name: Zippalanda
places.note: Uşaklı Höyük (Yozgat) proposed by its excavators; Mount Daḫa = Kerkenes Dağ.

places.name: Nerik
places.note: Oymaağaç Höyük (Vezirköprü); identification from tablets found on site. Point at the modern village.

places.name: Kaška
places.note: Peoples of the Pontic highlands north of Ḫattuša.

places.name: Kummanni
places.note: Traditionally classical Comana (Şar); debated. Cult centre of Kizzuwatna. Point approximate.

places.name: Ḫakmiš
places.note: Usually placed at or near Amasya.

places.name: Ḫurri / Mittani
places.note: The Hurrian lands of the upper Ḫabur; the kingdom of Mittani.

places.name: Zalpa
places.note: On the Black Sea near the mouth of the Kızılırmak; İkiztepe proposed.

places.name: Tapikka
places.note: Maşat Höyük (Tokat); letter archive found on site.

places.name: Aštata
places.note: Land on the middle Euphrates; capital Emar (Meskene).

places.name: Ura
places.note: Port on the Cilician coast, near Silifke.

places.name: Nuḫašše
places.note: Between the Orontes and the Euphrates, south of Aleppo.

places.name: Ḫulaya River Land
places.note: West of the Lower Land (Çarşamba basin?).

places.name: Ḫapalla
places.note: East of Mira, perhaps the Lake District.

places.name: Waššukanni
places.note: Capital of Mittani; Tell Fakhariya proposed.

places.name: Lower Land
places.note: South of the Kızılırmak, the Konya plain.
